market_says.text: Largest IPO on record — $81.3B raised, topping SpaceX’s $75B.
Opened at $111.50, +34% on the $83 offer price, for a fully diluted value of about $2 trillion at the open.
Shares faded about 9% from the open by midday, to ~$101 by 12:36pm ET.
Retail investors received about 15% of the offering, roughly $12B.
Index inclusion could bring about $19B of passive buying on the original 825M-share plan; on the final 980M shares the same math implies about $23B — our arithmetic, not the estimate’s.
Cboe expects to list ANT options on Nov 23, with market participants expecting heavy interest.
No analyst coverage yet — the quiet period runs to ~Dec 14.

path_to_check.quarters_note: The S-1 covers FY2023–FY2025 annuals + 9M 2026 interim, but the engine needs 4 public-company quarters. 4th: Q3 2027 10-Q, ~Nov 2027.

valuation_context.note: At the $83 offer price (~$1.5T fully diluted): ~18.5x run-rate sales. At ~$100/share (~$1.8T): ~22x. At the $111.50 open (~$2.0T): ~25x. Run-rate revenue is not accounting revenue.
At $100/share the outstanding-basis value is ~$1.32T. The $1.5T and $1.1T figures in coverage differ because they count shares differently — fully diluted vs outstanding.

ANT.what_it_does: Anthropic builds Claude, a family of frontier AI models, and sells it as an API, through cloud partners, and as a subscription (Claude Pro / Team / Enterprise). Revenue is usage-based fees plus subscriptions. The filing says past growth does not predict future growth — and growth is already decelerating sequentially: Q3 revenue rose 47% on Q2, after 144% before (CNBC).

CRWV.what_it_does: CoreWeave is a GPU cloud: it buys Nvidia chips, builds data centres around them, and rents the compute to AI developers under long contracts. Revenue is contracted and growing fast; the cost is debt-funded capacity, and interest now eats about a quarter of revenue.
